claims.verbatim:
The steamship Palmyra, from Liverpool on
the 16th, has arrived.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 30 July 1866, p. 1, col. 2
claims.verbatim:
The Cunard steamship Palmyra, Captain Watson, which
left Liverpool at one o'clock on the afternoon of the 17th,
and Queenstown on the 18th of July, arrived at this
port early yesterday morning.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 30 July 1866, p. 3, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Palmyra (Br), Watson, Liverpool, July 17, [cut]
Queenstown 18th, with mdse and 580 passengers, to E Cu-
nard. 26th, lat 43 36, lon 58 18, passed Brem bark James
Hayden, bound W; 27th, lat 42, lon 63 46, passed ship Conti-
net and Br bark Isabella, both bound W. Lat 40 29, lon
71 22, steamship City of Paris, bound E. Also a French
steamer bound E.
